'''Mike Gemme''' (GEMP handle '''BobbySapphire'''; also listed as '''Michael Gemme''') is a core member of [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]]. He played the [[2022 Regional Championships]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events/ 2022 Regional Championships], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020232529/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events-bf.html Internet Archive]</ref>
